learningObjectives: Identify the capacitor symbol by its two parallel plates separated by a gap, and distinguish it from the battery symbol
Explain how the parallel-plate structure lets a capacitor store energy in an electric field between the plates
Compare capacitor values written in microfarads, nanofarads, and picofarads and order 10uF, 100nF, 1000pF, and 47uF by capacitance
Draw correctly proportioned capacitor symbols in both horizontal and vertical orientations within a circuit diagram
